title: Mostly Reading: What Open-Book Scores Measure in Document-Level LoRA Adapters
abstract: arXiv:2610.31017v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Single-document LoRA adapters have been proposed as units of knowledge to be merged and retrieved; yet open-book scoring, with the document in the prompt, can credit a document's own adapter (its specialist) for reading that document as readily as for holding it. Training one adapter for each of 150 Wikipedia articles on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, we find that open-book scores mostly measure a reading behaviour every adapter shares: a random adapter trained on another document recovers 82 % of the specialist's open-book advantage over the base model but only 2 % of its advantage on a cloze probe that asks for the same document's facts without providing the source text, a share we cannot distinguish from zero. translated_title: 主要是阅读：开卷评分在文档级LoRA适配器中究竟衡量了什么
translated_abstract: 单文档LoRA适配器已被提出作为可合并与检索的知识单元；然而，开卷评分——即将文档放入提示词中——会同样容易地把功劳归给文档自己的适配器（其专用适配器）的“阅读”行为，而非真正“记住”该文档。我们在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上为150篇Wikipedia文章各训练一个适配器，发现开卷分数主要衡量的是每个适配器都共有的一种阅读行为：一个在其他文档上训练的随机适配器能够恢复专用适配器相对于基础模型82%的开卷优势，但在一个不提供源文本、直接询问同一文档事实的完形填空探测中，只能恢复其2%的优势——这一比例与零无法区分。文档内容确实写入了权重，因为专用适配器在完形回忆上比基础模型高出0.094，且其更新的几何结构遵循其所阅读的文档；然而，在一项包含30个查询的测试中，通过权重空间邻近性选择的适配器……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 开卷评分主要衡量的是所有适配器共有的“阅读”行为而非文档记忆——随机适配器即可恢复专用适配器82%的开卷优势，但在无源文本的完形测试中仅恢复约2%（与零无异），因此不宜用开卷评分来评估或选择文档级LoRA适配器。
en_tdlr: Open-book scores mostly measure a reading behavior shared by all adapters rather than true memorization—a random adapter recovers 82% of a document specialist's open-book advantage but only ~2% (indistinguishable from zero) on cloze probes—so open-book evaluation is unreliable for crediting or selecting document-level LoRA adapters.
